manager.notes: প্রথম release: Creative Assistant Manager, Premiere Bar, PS Bar। নতুন logo, Cobalt আর Premiere theme, আর update এখন সরাসরি app থেকে।

products.name: Premiere Bar
products.description: A slim toolbar for Premiere Pro, like the Tools panel. Sequence Option: pick a size (16:9, 4:5, 9:16 or custom) and a frame rate; the new sequence is named after the project (e.g. 47.1 (9x16)). Adjustment Layer: adds an adjustment layer over the In/Out range, the selected clips, or 5 seconds from the playhead, on a free track above. PR Organizer: sorts project files into Video, Audio, Images, Graphics and Sequences bins, and puts files no sequence uses into a red "Delete if you want" bin. Text: ready-made titles (English and Bangla) you can double-click or drag onto the timeline. Voice Enhance: enhance the voice of the selected clips (joined into one) or the entire timeline with Adobe Podcast (Speech/Music/Background sliders, WAV or MP3, live % and time) — the result goes on the track below and the originals are disabled. Needs Creative Assistant running. Pr Animate: After Effects-like animation in one click for the selected clips — text, photos, logos or video. In / Out (Fade, Fade Up, Slide, Pop, Bounce, Elastic, Zoom Out, Blur In, Wipe, Spin In), Loop (Pulse, Heartbeat, Float, Swing, Orbit, Spin, Blink), Wiggle (Wiggle, Wobble, Handheld, Jitter, Shake), and My presets (save your own animation and reuse it). Layers work together like in After Effects; click again to remove, Clear to reset. My Clips: save the In/Out part of any sequence (with its effects, texts and keyframes, and optionally a copy of the media) to your own library, then drag it onto the timeline or click to put it in the bin of any other project. Pr Track: motion tracking — box an object in a video clip (zoom in for small things), track it, and attach texts, PNGs or videos so they follow it (Position, Scale, Rotation, Smoothing, Motion blur). Needs Creative Assistant running. PR Paste: copy a picture anywhere (Chrome, Google, Finder), click PR Paste and it is saved next to the project and put straight into the Project panel; Shift-click also places it at the playhead on a free track, fitted to the frame. PR Snapshot: one click saves the frame at the playhead as a picture in the Project panel; Shift-click also places it at the playhead on a free track. Pr Subtitle: Bangla auto subtitles for the selected clips or the In/Out part — Reels style (the spoken word changes colour) or plain lines, with animation, and a chance to fix the text before it is placed. Uses your free Google Gemini key; needs Creative Assistant running. Black Fade: one click adds a soft black gradient at the bottom of the frame (the Iman Gadzhi look) over In/Out, the selected clips or 5 s; Shift-click to pick the side, size and darkness; change it later in Effect Controls. Tool Guide: point at any tool for a moment (or right-click it) to see a short video of how it works, with the steps written in Bangla under it; Bigger shows it large.

products.name: PS Bar
products.description: A slim toolbar for Photoshop. PS Safe Zone: open or create any document, then pick where it will be posted (Reels/Story/Shorts, Post 4:5, Square, YouTube Thumbnail, Video 16:9, YouTube Banner, Facebook Cover or a general 5% margin). The best choices for the document's size come first. It adds guides and a locked Safe Zone group on top that shows in red what gets cut or covered, and in green where text is safe. Hide, switch or remove it with one click; your own guides stay.
products.openHint: Plugins → PS Bar → Ps Bar (or PS Safe Zone)
